description: Ecommerce brands StackEnhance Signal tracks in one market, ranked by current email frequency (average marketing emails per week over the last 90 days), optionally within a category such as "Fashion & Apparel" or "Home & Interior". Use for questions like "Which brands email most frequently in Swedish ecommerce?" or to find a brand when the user names a kind of brand ("a Swedish fashion brand"). Rankings are available for SE, NO, DK, FI and DE. Brands with too little observed data are left out of rankings. Returns brand names, categories and emails per week only. Each brand has a details_url to cite.

category.description: Optional category, e.g. "Fashion & Apparel", "Home & Interior", "Beauty & Cosmetics", "Sports & Outdoor".

limit.description: How many brands to return (1-10, default 10).

market.description: Country as a two-letter code (SE, NO, DK, FI or DE) or its name ("Sweden").

name: find_brands
title: Find brands by email frequency
